title: floor vs ceil vs round
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{val: 5.5, floored: floor(5.5), ceiled: ceil(5.5), rounded: round(5.5)}

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{val: 5.5, floored: floor(5.5), ceiled: ceil(5.5), rounded: round(5.5)}

explanation.approach: floor always goes down, ceil always goes up, round goes to the nearest integer (0.5 rounds up).
